name: ntl
title: Night-time lights per capita
description: Annual night-time lights per capita for Bolivia's 339 municipalities, 2012–2020, in natural logs: the total VIIRS Day/Night Band radiance of each municipality divided by its population. A Hodrick–Prescott trend (λ = 400) of the same series isolates its long-run path. Night-time lights are a widely used proxy for local economic activity and electrification.

sources.title: Elvidge, C. D., Zhizhin, M., Ghosh, T., Hsu, F.-C., & Taneja, J. (2021). Annual time series of global VIIRS nighttime lights derived from monthly averages: 2012 to 2019. Remote Sensing, 13(5), 922.

geo:notes: Both variables are logs of a ratio, so they cannot be summed or averaged up the hierarchy; their aggregation rule is `none`. Aggregate the levels instead, e.g. NTL = exp(ln_NTLpc) × pop, summed with `pop` from the population dataset.
Computed by DS4Bolivia on its own municipal polygons (`asdf_id`), geoBoundaries v4 polygons that differ slightly from the geoBoundaries gbOpen boundaries in geo/boundaries/.
Population is the gridded estimate of the `pop` dataset.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: Municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 339-unit municipality map, numbered as in GADM 4.1; its boundary in geo/boundaries/ comes from geoBoundaries (GeoBolivia, public domain). It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: Calendar year of the observation (2012–2020). The 2012 lights composite covers April 2012 to March 2013.

fields.name: asdf_id
fields.title: DS4Bolivia polygon ID
fields.description: ID (AidData asdf_id) of the geoBoundaries v4 ADM3 polygon on which DS4Bolivia computed the data, matched one-to-one to the municipality by area overlap.

fields.name: ln_NTLpc
fields.title: Log night-time lights per capita
fields.description: Natural log of night-time radiance per person, ln(10⁸ × NTL / population). NTL is the sum over the municipality of the EOG Annual VIIRS Nighttime Lights V2 average radiance (background masked, 15 arc-seconds, nW/cm²/sr), extracted with AidData GeoQuery; population is the same year's WorldPop 1 km sum. Missing where no pixel remained lit after masking (2–15 municipalities a year).
fields.geo:source: EOG VIIRS nighttime lights and WorldPop, via DS4Bolivia

fields.name: ln_t400NTLpc
fields.title: Log night-time lights per capita (trend)
fields.description: Hodrick–Prescott trend (λ = 400) of the log of night-time lights per capita. The log of lights, gap-filled within each municipality by linear interpolation and extrapolation (and a fixed-effects prediction where needed), and the log of population are each HP-filtered and combined as ln(10⁸ × trend NTL / trend population). Complete for every municipality and year, including years where ln_NTLpc is missing.
fields.geo:source: EOG VIIRS nighttime lights and WorldPop, via DS4Bolivia
